name: PandaDoc
tagline: Create, manage, and send documents for electronic signature.
description: PandaDoc's hosted MCP server lets Cline search documents and templates, retrieve document details, create documents from templates, manage recipients, track document status, and send documents for electronic signature. Connect through PandaDoc OAuth and choose a workspace and access permissions. Access is limited to your selected workspace and existing user permissions.

install.notes: After installation, sign in to PandaDoc through OAuth and choose a workspace and access permissions. No API key or manually configured environment variable is required.
